content.comment_body: The [article_no] [product_name] supports up to 5kHz on inputs 3-6. Regarding the [article_no] expansion modules DM8 and DM16, specifically the ones with transistor outputs, do these have fast inputs or are they limited to slow (5Hz) types? I have been unable to locate any clear information on this.
No, the digital expansion modules do not have fast inputs. Only the base modules [product_name] 12/24 RCE(o) and 24CE(o) offer fast input capability.

analysis.insight_summary: Users requested specific technical details on high-speed (5kHz) input support for DM8 and DM16 digital expansion modules. Lack of accessible documentation led to some uncertainty while confirming product capabilities. This exchange emphasizes that incomplete technical specifications can cause delays or confusion for users searching for technical limits.
analysis.user_expectations: The expectation is for digital expansion modules to feature fast (5kHz) input support, or if not, for this limitation to be clearly and prominently stated in product documentation.
